title: See Beyond Personality
description: When analyzing behavior: - Ask for others: "What situations might have influenced their actions?" - Ask for yourself: "Am I underestimating my own tendencies in this scenario?" - Broaden the lens: Balance personality traits with situational influences for everyone. Example: If someone is late, consider traffic or unexpected delays, not just lack of punctuality.
